title: Mercedes Axor 2633 Factory fitted FUPS Bullbar #11
description: Axor 2633 hi-tensile aluminium Bullbar incorporating factory fitted FUPS. 76mm outer contoured pipes from drilled uprights bent to main channel and one piece shaped cross tube through drilled heavy duty uprights, Contoured main channel. Tow pin and heavy duty steel backing plate. Front mudflap mounts.
